content.short: Carrier is a token and NFT bridge for Web3 natives.
content.description: Carrier was designed to balance two goals that are often in tension: preserving user privacy amid the transparent, traceable nature of blockchains, and delivering a powerful, feature-rich experience that evolves with each user’s journey. By prioritizing a clean interface and thoughtful defaults, Carrier provides advanced capabilities without falling into unnecessary complexity, enabling users to navigate DeFi across multiple chains with confidence and privacy.
